_comment: Experimental: Orkeon Code on a Claude subscription, through the agent-cli provider of Orkeon (ADR-020 of Orkeon, ORKEXP010). The provider drives the claude command of this machine (the agent CLI of Anthropic, claude -p) signed in to its own subscription: install it, put it on the PATH and sign in once with claude /login. No API key reaches it: Orkeon removes every ANTHROPIC_* variable from its environment and refuses an answer made on a key (Llm:AgentCli:RequireLogin). Meant for personal use, on the subscription of whoever runs it, and for source mode only (ORKEON_CODE_MODE=source at the pin): the docker image has neither claude nor its login, and the 1.3.0 tool predates the provider. The Llm section is the default profile, the one of appsettings.anthropic.example.json, on the key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; Llm:Profiles:subscription is the profile on the subscription, and falls back on the default one when the subscription is at its limit, a limit Orkeon reads as a rate limit. Copy this file to config/appsettings.local.json (ignored by git), then, in the REPL, /config set llm.profile subscription: every crew a command launches builds its agents on it. Each call shows a cost of 0, the subscription pays; the CLI's own figure is kept as agent_cli_notional_cost_usd. Temperature, MaxTokens, a response format, thinking and /effort, cache breakpoints and Llm:WorkspaceId do not reach the CLI: each is warned about once per run. Llm:AgentCli sets how the CLI starts, at the runtime's defaults. The other sections are those of config/appsettings.example.json; see docs/configuration.md.
